items.summary: The Register reports that Mozilla faced a backlash from Firefox fans after apparently walking back promises not to sell their data, with the company responding through legal terms and explanations.

items.title: China tells its AI leaders to avoid U.S. travel over security concerns
items.title_zh: 中国以安全担忧为由要求 AI 领军人物避免赴美
items.summary: China has told its AI industry leaders to avoid travel to the United States over security concerns, according to the report.

items.title: Launch HN: Browser Use (YC W25) – open-source web agents
items.raw_content: Hey HN, we’re Gregor and Magnus, the founders of browser-use ( https://browser-use.com/ ), an easy way to connect AI agents with the browser. Our agent library is open-source ( https://github.com/browser-use/browser-use ) and we have what is the biggest open-source community for browser agents. And now we have a cloud offering—hence our Launch HN today! Check out this video to see it in action: https://preview.screen.studio/share/r1h4DuAk . There are lots more demos at https://github.com/browser-use/browser-use on how we control the web with prompts. We started coding a decade ago with Selenium bots and macros to automate tasks. Then we both moved into ML. Last November, we asked ourselves, “How hard could it be to build the interface between LLMs and the web?” We launched on Show HN ( https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=42052432 ) and have since been addressing various challenges of br
items.title_zh: Launch HN：Browser Use（YC W25）——开源网页智能体
items.summary: Browser Use founders Gregor and Magnus present their open-source library for connecting AI agents to the browser, along with a new cloud offering. They say it has the largest open-source community for browser agents, and that they began with Selenium bots and macros before moving into machine learning.

items.title: The benefits of learning in public
items.title_zh: 公开学习的益处
items.summary: The author reflects on how learning in public has helped them grow as an engineer and appears to benefit others too, and argues that they should do more of it.

items.title: It’s still worth blogging in the age of AI
items.title_zh: 在 AI 时代，写博客依然值得
items.summary: The author argues that although AI might seem to make blogging pointless, writing blog posts is still worthwhile.

items.title: ForeverVM: Run AI-generated code in stateful sandboxes that run forever
items.title_zh: ForeverVM：在永久运行的有状态沙箱中执行 AI 生成的代码
items.summary: The team behind Jamsocket built ForeverVM, a code-execution product that uses memory snapshotting to present a Python REPL that appears to live forever. It is meant to free app developers from thinking about sandboxes starting and stopping when they give LLMs code-running tools.

items.title: Y Combinator deletes posts after a startup's demo goes viral
items.title_zh: Y Combinator 删除帖子：一家初创公司的演示视频走红
items.summary: Y Combinator deleted a controversial demo video from one of its startups after the demo went viral, according to TechCrunch. The startup's product uses AI cameras to monitor factory workers.

items.title: Solitaire
items.title_zh: 纸牌接龙
items.summary: The creator of Balatro reflects on how the card game solitaire, or Klondike, served as a central inspiration for the design of Balatro.

items.title: Mozilla deletes promise to never sell Firefox data
items.title_zh: Mozilla 删除了“永不出售 Firefox 数据”的承诺
items.summary: According to a post shared on X, Mozilla has removed a commitment stating that it would never sell Firefox user data.

items.title: Windows NT for GameCube/Wii
items.title_zh: 适用于 GameCube/Wii 的 Windows NT
items.summary: A GitHub project ports the PowerPC version of Windows NT to Nintendo's GameCube, Wii and Wii U consoles.

items.title: Why do we have both CSRF protection and CORS?
items.title_zh: 为什么我们同时需要 CSRF 防护和 CORS？
items.summary: The post explains why both CSRF protection and CORS exist, describing how cross-site request forgery works and why popular web frameworks still include built-in defenses.

items.title: Hard problems that reduce to document ranking
items.title_zh: 可归约为文档排序的难题
items.summary: The post argues that LLMs can perform listwise document ranking effectively and that some complex problems can be reframed as document-ranking tasks. The author describes using the approach for patch diffing to locate N-day vulnerabilities and published a command-line tool called raink.

items.title: The Miserable State of Modems and Mobile Network Operators
items.title_zh: 调制解调器与移动网络运营商的糟糕现状
items.summary: A Golioth blog post recounts the complexity of cellular connectivity, the pitfalls of closed ecosystems and the difficulty of debugging problems that cannot be observed directly.

items.title: China’s SAIC partners with Huawei to tackle competition from BYD
items.title_zh: 上汽与华为合作，应对比亚迪的竞争
items.summary: SAIC is partnering with Huawei as it loses its long-held lead in Chinese car sales; BYD sold more than 4.2 million passenger vehicles to take the top spot.

items.title: Former Google DeepMind VP joins ByteDance as Seed team research lead
items.title_zh: 前 Google DeepMind 副总裁加入字节跳动，领导 Seed 团队基础研究
items.summary: Dr. Wu Yonghui, formerly a vice president at Google DeepMind, has joined ByteDance as head of foundational research for Seed, the company's large-model team.

items.title: Boston Dynamics tests robots from Unitree Robotics: report
items.title_zh: 报道：波士顿动力测试宇树科技机器人
items.summary: Boston Dynamics founder Marc Raibert told Yicai Global that his intelligent robotics research institute had tested robots from Unitree Robotics, according to the report.

items.title: Lanma Tech embroiled in salary dispute amid financial struggles
items.title_zh: Lanma Tech 陷入薪资纠纷，财务承压
items.summary: Chinese AI firm Lanma Tech, founded by Zhou Jian, is facing scrutiny over unpaid salaries and benefits amid financial difficulties, according to a Chinese media report.

items.title: BYD to launch affordable electric SUV in France
items.title_zh: 比亚迪将在法国推出平价电动 SUV
items.summary: BYD is set to launch an affordable electric SUV in France, according to TechNode.

items.title: Li Auto shares surge after teasing its first all-electric SUV with new picture
items.title_zh: 理想汽车预告首款纯电 SUV 新图，股价大涨
items.summary: Li Auto's shares rose 13.2% on Nasdaq on Tuesday after the Chinese EV maker teased the i8, its first all-electric SUV, with a new picture.

items.title: Chinese GPU firm MetaX plans to lay off 200 employees ahead of IPO launch
items.title_zh: 中国 GPU 厂商 MetaX 计划在 IPO 前裁员 200 人
items.summary: Chinese GPU maker MetaX plans to lay off around 200 employees, about 20% of its 900-person workforce, ahead of its IPO, according to local media.

items.title: Mercedes-Benz China starts layoff process after weak sales
items.title_zh: 销量疲软后，梅赛德斯-奔驰中国启动裁员
items.summary: Mercedes-Benz has begun layoffs mainly in its China sales and financing units, becoming the latest foreign automaker to cut costs after weak sales.

items.title: Xiaomi unveils flagship 15 Ultra phone as its 15th anniversary approaches
items.title_zh: 小米 15 周年之际发布旗舰手机 15 Ultra
items.summary: Xiaomi's most advanced phone so far packs the Snapdragon 8 Elite chip, a 200MP main camera, a 2K screen and a 6,000mAh battery, and adds satellite communication support.

items.title: Ten million meals, zero safety nets — JD.com aims to change it
items.title_zh: 一千万份餐食，零安全保障——京东希望改变这一切
items.summary: TechNode examines how migrant delivery riders have become vital to urban life in China since the first online food order in 2008, and how JD.com aims to change their lack of safety nets.

items.title: Liuziyu77/Visual-RFT
items.title_zh: Liuziyu77/Visual-RFT：视觉强化微调官方代码库
items.summary: This is the official repository for Visual-RFT, on visual reinforcement fine-tuning, and Visual-ARFT, its agentic extension, implemented in Jupyter Notebook.

items.title: SparkAudio/Spark-TTS
items.title_zh: Spark-TTS：语音合成推理代码
items.summary: Spark-TTS is a Python repository that provides inference code for a text-to-speech model.

items.title: AtalayaLabs/OxiCloud
items.title_zh: AtalayaLabs/OxiCloud：基于 Rust 的自托管云存储
items.summary: OxiCloud is a self-hosted cloud storage project written in Rust that combines files, photos, calendars and contacts in one place, pitched as ultra-fast, secure and lightweight.

items.title: Justsenger/ExHyperV
items.title_zh: ExHyperV：Hyper-V 神器
items.summary: ExHyperV is a C# project that its author bills as the “Excalibur” of Hyper-V.

items.title: PeterGriffinJin/Search-R1
items.title_zh: Search-R1：面向推理与搜索引擎调用的高效强化学习训练框架
items.summary: Search-R1 is described as an efficient, scalable reinforcement learning training framework for LLMs that interleave reasoning with search engine calls; it is built on veRL and written in Python.

items.title: arkflow-rs/arkflow
items.title_zh: arkflow-rs/arkflow：高性能 Rust 流处理引擎
items.summary: A high-performance stream processing engine written in Rust that integrates AI capabilities for real-time data processing and intelligent analysis.

items.title: TanayK07/expo-react-native-cicd
items.title_zh: expo-react-native-cicd：基于 GitHub Actions 的免费 Expo 构建流水线
items.summary: The project offers a free alternative to Expo EAS builds, providing a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline for React Native and Expo apps with automated testing and flexible deployment.

items.title: suyoumo/ClawProBench
items.title_zh: ClawProBench：评估 OpenClaw 运行时 LLM 智能体的基准工具
items.summary: ClawProBench is a live-first benchmark harness written in Rust for evaluating LLM agents in the OpenClaw runtime, using deterministic grading and repeated trials to measure reliability.

items.title: Comfy-Org/workflow_templates
items.title_zh: ComfyUI 工作流模板合集
items.summary: The Comfy-Org repository collects template workflows for ComfyUI, with its code written in TypeScript.

items.title: stanford-cs336/lectures
items.title_zh: stanford-cs336/lectures：斯坦福 CS336 课程讲义
items.summary: The repository hosts lecture materials for Stanford's CS336 course, with Python listed as the primary language.

items.title: Contextual Quantum Neural Networks for Stock Price Prediction
items.title_zh: 面向股票价格预测的语境化量子神经网络
items.summary: The paper proposes a contextual quantum neural network for multi-asset stock price prediction, introducing a quantum batch gradient update and a quantum multi-task learning architecture. Experiments on S&P 500 data for Apple, Google, Microsoft and Amazon show it outperforms quantum single-task learning models.

items.title: Evaluating System 1 vs. 2 Reasoning Approaches for Zero-Shot Time Series Forecasting: A Benchmark and Insights
items.title_zh: 评估零样本时间序列预测中的 System 1 与 System 2 推理方法：基准与洞见
items.summary: Researchers present ReC4TS, a benchmark that evaluates reasoning strategies for zero-shot time-series forecasting across eight domains. They report that self-consistency is the most effective test-time strategy and that group-relative policy optimization works better for post-training.

items.title: À la recherche du sens perdu: your favourite LLM might have more to say than you can understand
items.title_zh: 寻找失落的意义：你钟爱的 LLM 也许话里有话
items.summary: The authors report that LLMs can attach hidden meanings to sequences that look incomprehensible to humans, test this behavior across many models and link it partly to spurious correlations from BPE tokenization; they show the effect can help jailbreak older models, reaching an attack success rate of 0.4 on gpt-4o mini.

items.title: Aligning Compound AI Systems via System-level DPO
items.title_zh: 通过系统级 DPO 对齐复合 AI 系统
items.summary: The paper models compound AI systems as directed acyclic graphs and introduces SysDPO, which extends direct preference optimisation to joint system-level alignment. Two variants, SysDPO-Direct and SysDPO-Sampling, are evaluated on aligning a language model with a diffusion model and on an LLM collaboration system.

items.title: H-FLTN: A Privacy-Preserving Hierarchical Framework for Electric Vehicle Spatio-Temporal Charge Prediction
items.title_zh: H-FLTN：面向电动汽车时空充电预测的隐私保护分层框架
items.summary: The paper proposes H-FLTN, a three-tier hierarchical federated learning framework using transformer-based learning, secure aggregation and secret sharing to predict EV charging demand while preserving user privacy. Dynamic client capping and client rotation are added to keep training efficient as the number of participating vehicles grows.

items.title: Interpreting CLIP with Hierarchical Sparse Autoencoders
items.title_zh: 用分层稀疏自编码器解读 CLIP
items.summary: The authors introduce Matryoshka SAE, a sparse-autoencoder architecture that learns hierarchical features at multiple granularities to interpret vision-language models such as CLIP. They report 0.99 cosine similarity at roughly 80% sparsity and use the method to extract more than 120 semantic concepts for tasks including bias analysis.

items.title: Development of an Unpaired Deep Neural Network for Synthesizing X-ray Fluoroscopic Images from Digitally Reconstructed Tomography in Image Guided Radiotherapy
items.title_zh: 从数字重建断层图像合成 X 射线透视图像的非配对深度神经网络
items.summary: A modified CycleGAN trained on more than 400 DRR-FPD image pairs from lung cancer patients generates flat-panel detector images from digitally reconstructed radiographs. The model beat input DRR images and a U-Net baseline on MAE, PSNR, SSIM and KID, generating images in milliseconds.

items.title: Personalize Your LLM: Fake it then Align it
items.title_zh: 个性化你的 LLM：先伪造，再对齐
items.summary: The authors introduce CHAMELEON, a personalization approach that combines self-generated preference data with representation editing, reporting an average 40% improvement over two baselines across two model architectures on tasks including LaMP.

items.title: Bridging Information Gaps with Comprehensive Answers: Improving the Diversity and Informativeness of Follow-Up Questions
items.title_zh: 以全面回答弥合信息差：提升追问的多样性与信息量
items.summary: The paper proposes an information-gap-driven distillation pipeline in which a teacher LLM writes a comprehensive answer, contrasts it with an initial answer and derives gap-bridging follow-up questions. Fine-tuned student models trained on a tenfold-augmented FollowupQG dataset produce more informative and diverse follow-up questions.

items.title: Synergy Between Sufficient Changes and Sparse Mixing Procedure for Disentangled Representation Learning
items.title_zh: 充分变化与稀疏混合过程的协同：解耦表示学习
items.summary: The authors show that two previously separate assumptions, sufficient distribution changes and a sparse mixing procedure, can complement each other to achieve identifiability in disentangled representation learning, and build an estimation framework with VAE and GAN implementations.
